basicmoves1_dsc: When you use a clever trick to seize the upper hand or avoid a sticky situation, roll +VINEGAR. On a 7-9, your tricks work but there’s a catch; the Fates will tell you what it costs to follow through. On a 10+, you pull it off spectacularly; mark 1-luck.
basicmoves2_dsc:
When you get into a scrap, roll +BLOOD. On a hit, deal your weapon’s harm to your opponent, or deal half your weapon’s harm (rounded down) and pick 1 of the following options. On a 7-9, your opponent may respond how they’d like. On a 10+, you also seize the ante.
◆you seize something from them
◆you force them into a precarious new position
◆ you intimidate them and compel them to back off
